$comment: Phase 39. The contract between Domain/Common/RichText.cs and shared/rich-text/rich-text.ts.
Read by rich-text.spec.ts (Angular) and by RichTextSharedCasesTests (Domain.UnitTests, which
links this file in as an embedded resource). Neither implementation is the source of truth for
the other; this file is, which is the same arrangement phase 26b made for BsCalendar and its
Only WELL-FORMED input belongs here. The two parsers reach the tree by different routes -- the
server tokenizes by hand, the client uses DOMParser -- and they are not required to agree about
how to repair malformed markup, because the server's answer is the one that gets stored. What
they must agree about is every shape a user can actually produce in the editor.
